name: FIDO2 Security Key Suite
author: Erijl
description: Unlock the Omarchy lock screen, sudo and polkit with one or more FIDO2/U2F security keys (YubiKey, Token2, Nitrokey) through pam_u2f, with a panel and bar widget for enrolling and removing credentials, minting hardware-backed ed25519-sk SSH keys, and locking the session when the key is pulled out.

barWidget.description: Key glyph that dims when no security key is attached; click opens the suite panel
